heard: The iconic horse head nebula is slowly erasing itself into nothing. This massive tower of dust sits roughly 1,400 light years away in Orion. It stretches three light years across, blocking the glowing hydrogen gas behind it. A former Harvard maid named Wilhelmina Fleming first spotted the silhouette in 1888. Ultraviolet radiation from nearby stars is relentlessly carving into the dust. Astronomers estimate this photo evaporation will completely erase the pillar within 5 million years. That is how the iconic Horsehead Nebula erases itself into nothing.
